flows.title: Run the service
flows.goal: The user can configure and start the service, have migrations applied before listening, see the masked startup line, and confirm the service is healthy.

milestones.claimTitle: Each documented setting uses its default value when its environment variable is unset and is overridden by its own environment variable when set.
milestones.note: Configuration determines which database and address the service uses before startup.

milestones.claimTitle: On startup, the service applies every migration in `migrations/` against the database it is configured for before the service is listening.
milestones.note: Migrations complete before the service begins listening.

milestones.claimTitle: Once the service is up, it prints one line naming the address it is listening on and the database it is using, with the password masked.
milestones.note: The startup line confirms the service is listening and reports the configured database safely.

milestones.claimTitle: `GET /healthz` answers `200` with `{"status":"ok","service":"bookclub"}` as soon as the service is listening.
milestones.note: The health check confirms the listening service is ready.

flows.title: Add a book and prevent another copy of the same ISBN
flows.goal: A member can add a book with a normalized ISBN, and the shelf rejects a second copy without changing the shelf.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books accepts an ISBN-10 or an ISBN-13, with or without hyphens and spaces, and stores the thirteen-digit form returned as the book's isbn.
milestones.note: First the book is added to the shelf.

milestones.claimTitle: Adding an ISBN that is already on the shelf is answered 409 with {"error":"that book is already on the shelf"}, and the shelf is left as it was.
milestones.note: Then the same ISBN is added again to confirm one-copy-per-ISBN behavior.

flows.title: Finish and re-finish a book
flows.goal: A member can mark a book finished and later mark it finished again so its finished timestamp is updated.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books/{id}/finish moves a book to finished, stamps finishedAt with the moment it was marked, and answers 200 with the book in its new state.
milestones.note: The book is first moved into the finished state.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books/{id}/finish re-stamps a book that is already finished.
milestones.note: The same finished book is marked finished again.

flows.title: Browse the public shelf without credentials
flows.goal: A reader can view books without credentials while archived books are hidden or reported as archived.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books and GET /books/{id} need no credentials.
milestones.note: The reader uses the public read operations.

milestones.claimTitle: An archived book does not appear in GET /books.
milestones.note: The public list omits archived books.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books/{id} for an archived book answers 410 with {"error":"book archived"} rather than the book.
milestones.note: A direct read of an archived book reports that it is archived.

flows.title: Reject an invalid ISBN
flows.goal: A member gets a validation error when trying to add a book with a value that is not a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books refuses a value that is neither a valid ISBN-10 nor a valid ISBN-13 with 400 and {"error":"isbn must be a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13"}.
milestones.note: The add-book attempt fails validation.

flows.title: Reject shelf changes without a valid member token
flows.goal: A non-member or invalid-token caller cannot add or finish books, and no shelf state is written.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books and POST /books/{id}/finish without a member token or with a token the club's secret does not verify are answered 401 with {"error":"authentication required"} and nothing is written.
milestones.note: The write attempt is denied before changing the shelf.

flows.title: Keep a member token working after restart
flows.goal: A member can continue using the same token after the service restarts.

milestones.claimTitle: A member token keeps working after the service restarts.
milestones.note: The member token remains valid across restart.

flows.title: Print configuration with a redacted database password
flows.goal: The user can inspect the service configuration while keeping the database password hidden.

milestones.claimTitle: `bookclub config` prints the configuration the service would use, one setting per line, and exits `0`.
milestones.note: First the command prints the configuration.

milestones.claimTitle: The database line printed by `bookclub config` always replaces its password with `***`.
milestones.note: The printed configuration redacts the password.

flows.title: Reject an unsupported database scheme
flows.goal: The user gets a clear configuration error when the database scheme is not Postgres.

milestones.claimTitle: If `DATABASE_URL` names a scheme other than Postgres, `bookclub config` writes `error: unsupported database scheme "<scheme>" — bookclub speaks postgres and postgresql` to stderr and exits `2`.
milestones.note: This is an error path for the config command.

flows.title: Convert a valid ISBN
flows.goal: The user can normalize a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 into its thirteen-digit form.

milestones.claimTitle: `bookclub isbn <value>` prints the thirteen-digit form of a valid ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, ignoring hyphens and spaces in the input, and exits `0`.
milestones.note: This is the successful ISBN conversion path.

flows.title: Refuse an invalid ISBN
flows.goal: The user gets a clear error when the ISBN value is invalid.

milestones.claimTitle: `bookclub isbn <value>` refuses an invalid ISBN by writing `error: "<value>" is not a valid ISBN` to stderr and exiting `2`.
milestones.note: This is an error path for an invalid ISBN value.

flows.title: Require an ISBN value
flows.goal: The user gets a clear error when invoking the ISBN command without a value.

milestones.claimTitle: Calling `bookclub isbn` with no value writes `error: isbn needs a value` and exits `2`.
milestones.note: This is an error path for a missing ISBN value.

flows.title: Show help
flows.goal: The user can request usage text that includes commands and options.

milestones.claimTitle: `bookclub --help` or `bookclub -h`, in place of any command, writes the usage, including the command list and options, to stdout and exits `0`.
milestones.note: This is the explicit help path.

flows.title: Show version
flows.goal: The user can request the CLI version.

milestones.claimTitle: `bookclub --version` or `bookclub -V`, in place of any command, writes `bookclub` followed by the version and exits `0`.
milestones.note: This is the version path.

flows.title: Show usage when no arguments are provided
flows.goal: The user gets usage text as an error when no command or option is provided.

milestones.claimTitle: Run with no arguments, `bookclub` writes the same usage text to stderr and exits `2`.
milestones.note: This is the missing-arguments error path.

flows.title: Reject an unknown command
flows.goal: The user gets a clear error when entering a command the CLI does not define.

milestones.claimTitle: An undefined `bookclub` command writes `error: unknown command "<name>"` to stderr and exits `2`.
milestones.note: This is the unknown-command error path.

flows.title: GET /healthz returns bookclub ok
flows.goal: The user can confirm the service is healthy and identifies itself as bookclub.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /healthz returns a 200 response with an application/json body whose status is "ok" and service is "bookclub".
milestones.note: Health is a standalone availability check.

flows.title: Add, list, get, and finish a book
flows.goal: The user can add a book, see it on the shelf, retrieve it by id, and mark it finished.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books with a valid member token and a JSON body containing isbn, title, and author returns 201 with the book that was added as an application/json object containing id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt.
milestones.note: Adding the book creates the shelf item used by the later steps.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books returns a 200 application/json response containing a required books array whose items are book objects with required id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt fields.
milestones.note: The shelf listing exposes the added book objects with their required fields.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books lists the books on the shelf most recently added first.
milestones.note: The listing order is part of the shelf view after books are added.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books/{id} returns 200 with an application/json book object containing id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt when the book is found.
milestones.note: The id from the added book can be used to retrieve that book.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books/{id}/finish with a valid member token marks the book with that integer id as finished and returns 200 with an application/json book object including id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt.
milestones.note: The retrieved book can then be marked finished.

flows.title: Add a duplicate ISBN
flows.goal: The user gets a conflict error when trying to add a book whose ISBN is already on the shelf.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books with a valid member token and a JSON body containing isbn, title, and author returns 201 with the book that was added as an application/json object containing id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt.
milestones.note: The first add puts the ISBN on the shelf.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books returns 409 with an application/json object containing an error string when a book with the same ISBN is already on the shelf.
milestones.note: The second add attempts to reuse that ISBN.

flows.title: POST /books missing or unusable fields
flows.goal: The user gets a validation error when isbn, title, or author is missing or unusable.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books returns 400 with an application/json object containing an error string when the isbn, title, or author is missing or unusable.
milestones.note: This is a standalone validation failure for adding a book.

flows.title: POST /books without a valid member token
flows.goal: The user gets an authentication error when adding a book without a valid member token.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books returns 401 with an application/json object containing an error string when no valid member token is sent.
milestones.note: This is a standalone authentication failure for adding a book.

flows.title: GET /books/{id} when no book has that id
flows.goal: The user gets a not-found error when retrieving a book id that does not exist.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books/{id} returns 404 with an application/json object containing an error string when no book has that id.
milestones.note: This is a standalone not-found case for retrieving a book.

flows.title: GET /books/{id} when the book has been archived
flows.goal: The user gets a gone error when retrieving an archived book.

milestones.claimTitle: GET /books/{id} returns 410 with an application/json object containing an error string when the book has been archived.
milestones.note: This is a standalone archived-book retrieval case.

flows.title: POST /books/{id}/finish without a valid member token
flows.goal: The user gets an authentication error when trying to finish a book without a valid member token.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books/{id}/finish without a valid member token returns 401 with an application/json object containing an error string.
milestones.note: This is a standalone authentication failure for finishing a book.

flows.title: POST /books/{id}/finish for an id with no book
flows.goal: The user gets a not-found error when trying to finish a book id that does not exist.

milestones.claimTitle: POST /books/{id}/finish for an id with no book returns 404 with an application/json object containing an error string.
milestones.note: This is a standalone not-found case for finishing a book.

flows.title: Start bookclub and manage a book on the shelf
flows.goal: The user starts the service, verifies it is healthy, then adds, views, and finishes a book through the API.

milestones.claimTitle: Each documented setting uses its default value when its environment variable is unset and is overridden by its own environment variable when set.
On startup, the service applies every migration in `migrations/` against the database it is configured for before the service is listening.
Once the service is up, it prints one line naming the address it is listening on and the database it is using, with the password masked.
`GET /healthz` answers `200` with `{"status":"ok","service":"bookclub"}` as soon as the service is listening.

POST /books with a valid member token and a JSON body containing isbn, title, and author returns 201 with the book that was added as an application/json object containing id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt.
GET /books returns a 200 application/json response containing a required books array whose items are book objects with required id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt fields.
GET /books lists the books on the shelf most recently added first.
GET /books/{id} returns 200 with an application/json book object containing id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt when the book is found.

POST /books/{id}/finish with a valid member token marks the book with that integer id as finished and returns 200 with an application/json book object including id, isbn, title, author, status, addedAt, and finishedAt.

noFlowClaims.claimTitle: `bookclub` never opens a database connection and never talks to the service.
noFlowClaims.reason: This describes a static global property of the CLI rather than a user goal path.
